exceptions.rationale: Development-only Mocha diff rendering via the pinned test suite; untrusted patch input is never processed and the shipped extension has zero runtime dependencies.

Development-only glob usage inside the pinned Mocha and @vscode/test-cli spec discovery paths. The advisory requires traversal to be cancelled through AbortSignal; repository test commands do not drive abortable glob traversal, and the shipped extension has zero runtime dependencies.

Development-only minimatch usage inside the pinned Mocha and @vscode/test-cli matching paths against checked-in spec patterns. Patterns are not attacker-controlled and the shipped extension has zero runtime dependencies.
Development-only Mocha parallel-worker option serialization; the reviewed test commands do not enable Mocha parallel mode, so this path is not reached in CI or the shipped extension.
